title: Get a permit to busk or perform in public places
what: Get the council's permit before busking or performing in streets, malls or other public places.

laws.title: Public Land and Council Assets Local Law 2014

sources.title: Busker street performer permit brisbane city council
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this permit to busk or provide entertainment in a public place for money or other type of reward.
